purpose: Test whether the host-contribution architecture signal is driven by any single butterfly family or any single WGSRPD Level-1 botanical continent.
source: Use exactly the species-host-region reconstruction produced by the prospectively frozen GEB generality audit; do not reacquire or alter upstream biological data.
primary_population: host-taxonomy-adequate species with introduced-host resource expansion under the existing manuscript definition

leave_one_butterfly_family_out.procedure: For every represented butterfly family, remove all species in that family and recompute the two global Spearman associations.
metrics: rho(host-family breadth, maximum single-host fractional share)

leave_one_level1_out.procedure: For every WGSRPD Level-1 botanical continent, remove all resource units in that Level-1 region, rebuild each species' remaining introduced-added host contribution architecture, then recompute the two global Spearman associations.
metrics: rho(host-family breadth, maximum single-host fractional share)
